extraction_notes: Main quantitative performance data are in Table 6 and Figure 7. Figure 7 bar-chart values for CO2 conversion and selectivities were read approximately where not printed in the text. Time-on-stream plots in Figures 8 and S6 contain many closely spaced points and no data table; only the paper-level stability statement is noted, not extracted point-by-point. Supporting-information figures/tables are referenced but not provided here, so only SI-related values printed in the main text were extracted.
